# cases; a 65-byte r||s||v signature has no DER to get wrong) are left out.
# The remaining 190 give (r, s) over sha256(msg).
# The expected recoveries come from @noble/curves 1.x
# `Signature(r, s, recId).recoverPublicKey`, an independent implementation.
#
# Columns: tcId digest r s signer rec0 rec1 expect
#   signer  the address of the test group's public key
#   rec0/1  the address recovered with recId 0/1 ("-": no valid recovery)
#   expect  valid: Wycheproof accepts it (high-s included), so rec0 or rec1 is the signer
#           largex: valid, but only with recId 2/3 (x(kG) >= n); ethers never makes these
#           invalid: Wycheproof rejects it; neither recId gives the signer
